summary: Feed s082_single to SIEM is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely missing. All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, one-way, drops, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN ingress is stripping 802.1Q tags - ingress port likely set as access/untagged or broker policy set to 'strip VLAN' instead of trunk passthrough, so VLANs 10 and 20 never reach the SIEM.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses VLAN segmentation context for VLANs 10 and 20; correlation, filtering and detection rules scoped to those VLANs will never match, creating blind spot for those segments despite tool not needing full payload or bidirectional flow.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the packet broker to the SIEM so required segmentation is restored and SIEM detection coverage matches its profile.
